figurative_meaning_en: A person fully conscious of their self-interests
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা সেয়ানা পাগল, নিজের লাভের খবর কখনো ভোলে না।
ব্যবসায়ে সফল হওয়ার জন্য সেয়ানা পাগল হয়ে উঠতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a shrewd madman; he never forgets his own gain.
To succeed in business, you have to become a shrewd madman.
note: This idiom highlights the blend of apparent folly with underlying cleverness in Bengali cultural expression.
